individual-data-points.explanation: These are spatial heatmap overlays on tissue sections showing deconvolution scores per spot; heatmaps are exempt from requiring individual data points.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Spatial heatmap plots show per-spot values with a color scale, not error bars or box/whisker elements, so no definition is needed.

individual-data-points.explanation: Individual sample dots are overlaid on each box plot for both T11b-high LUSC and LUAD groups.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: The box plots represent the distribution of values for each group, extending from the 25th percentile to the 75th percentile; T11b-high LUSC: Classical monocyte (minima=0.00035, median=0.32265, maxima=1, Q1 = 0.16193, Q3 = 0.52806)...
error-bars-defined.explanation: Box plot elements (quartiles, median, minima/maxima) are explicitly defined with numeric values in the caption.

individual-data-points.explanation: GSEA enrichment plots are line plots, which are exempt from requiring individual data points.

error-bars-defined.explanation: GSEA enrichment line plots show a running enrichment score curve with no error bars.

individual-data-points.explanation: Bar graph presents a single Log2 fold-change value per gene from the DEG analysis without any underlying individual data points shown.

error-bars-defined.explanation: The bar graph shows single fold-change values with p-values annotated above bars and has no error bars to define.

individual-data-points.explanation: Panel E shows H&E and IHC micrographs, not a plot.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Panel E shows H&E and IHC micrographs, not a plot, so error bars do not apply.
